frontendRules: All /api/v1 routes except register and login need Authorization: Bearer <token>.
On 401, clear the token and send the user to login.
Personal notes live under /api/v1/notes. Team notes live under /api/v1/teams/:id/notes. Do not mix the lists.
createdBy and teamId on notes come from the server. Ignore those fields if the form sends them.
Treat 404 on a team route as 'this team is not available', including when the user is not a member.
Show OWNER-only actions only when data.role is OWNER: rename team, delete team, add member, change role, remove member.
ADMIN and MEMBER can create, read, update, and delete team notes, and can list members.
There is no GET /api/v1/teams/:id/notes/:noteId. Open a team note from the team notes list.
/api/tasks is not part of the product API.
